description: Searches the operations of the Chain Daddy REST API, documented at https://docs.chaindaddy.io/api-reference/explorer (OpenAPI: https://docs.chaindaddy.io/openapi.yaml) that an AI app may use, beyond the tools listed here: token pages, holders and community, broadcasts, alerts, deals, airdrop drafts, polls, Crown Apps, the developer program, Sign in with Chain Daddy, notifications, listings and more. Returns each match's tool name, what it does, whether it reads or changes something (`callWith`), whether it needs sign-in, and its input schema. No operation here moves money or tokens: paying, launching, claiming and trading happen on chaindaddy.io.

limit.description: How many operations to return (1-25, default 8).

query.description: What to do or read, in plain words (e.g. "holder segments", "alert rules", "my deals").

name: find_api_operations
title: Find API operations
